roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD. This pivotal role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and compliance within our facility. You will play a key role in fostering a culture of continuous learning and safety.

In this dual capacity, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive staff education programs, as well as overseeing all aspects of infection prevention and control. Your expertise will be vital in maintaining a safe and healthy environment for both residents and staff, adhering to all state and federal regulations.

This is an excellent opportunity for an RN passionate about education and public health to make a significant impact in a supportive and dynamic setting.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Demonstrated experience in staff education and development
Proven experience in infection prevention and control practices
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations related to staff development and infection control

description: We are seeking a dedicated Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Inverness, FL. This PRN opportunity allows for flexible scheduling while contributing to patient recovery and well-being. As a PTA, you will work under the supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist, assisting with the implementation of individualized treatment plans. Your responsibilities will include providing therapeutic exercises, modalities, and patient education to help residents regain mobility and function. This role is ideal for a compassionate professional looking to make a significant impact on patients' lives on an as-needed basis. Join a team committed to delivering high-quality rehabilitative care.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) program
Current and valid Florida state PTA license
Ability to work on an as-needed (PRN) basis
